verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes up to 228 GB/s of LPDDR5x memory bandwidth, which covers the bandwidth half of the story. It also documents on-device generative-AI tooling (AI Hub, GenieX) with quantization support. However, Qualcomm explicitly publishes no maximum memory capacity, so there is no evidence the platform can hold a quantized 70B-class model, and no benchmark or hands-on report shows such a model running. Missing for 10: published max addressable memory capacity, evidence of 70B-class quantized models running, token-throughput figures, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a large local LLM (70B-class, quantized) on this platform — enough addressable memory and published memory bandwidth to make local inference practical

citations.quote: up to 228 GB/s LPDDR5x memory bandwidth, as stated by Qualcomm
